% fvextra's \UseVerb with a background color after a verbatim block: the
% block keeps the page's background and text color, and the saved text is
% inline, on yellow or in red. \EscVerb and \Verb are red. All of them
% look as in the PDF.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{xcolor,fvextra}
\SaveVerb{v}|uvc-text_a|
\begin{document}
Before the block.
\begin{Verbatim}
uvc-block
\end{Verbatim}
Yellow \UseVerb[backgroundcolor=yellow]{v} end.

Red \UseVerb[formatcom=\color{red}]{v} end.

Unextra \UseVerb[extra=false,formatcom=\color{red}]{v} end.

Escaped \EscVerb[formatcom=\color{red}]{uvc-esc\_e} end.

Verb \Verb[formatcom=\color{red}]|uvc-verb_v| end.
\end{document}
